name: Doznačena stabla po šumarijama i vrstama drveća (2015)
title: Doznačena stabla po šumarijama i vrstama drveća (2015)
description: Records of doznačena stabla (trees officially designated for cutting) in Croatian state forests for the year 2015, broken down by uprava šuma (forestry administration), šumarija (local forestry office) and vrsta drveta (tree species). Source data is published by Hrvatske šume d.o.o. via the Code for Croatia open-data repository. Each record carries codes and names for the uprava and šumarija plus the species code and name, and the count of designated trees (doznaceno).
